notes: Thin run (6 entries, 2 x 24 h). WebFetch only accepts URLs that appear in search results or in raw fetched pages, and search returned almost no clinic own-sites, so cmvro.ro, ANSVSA, USAMV Timișoara and most clinic sites could not be opened. Known 24-h / non-stop hospitals reported only by news (no phone or own page opened, therefore NOT listed): Pet Stuff (Bucharest, Sector 6), Vet 4 Life (Bucharest), SuperVet (Ilfov), Spitalul Veterinar Transilvania (Iulius Town Timișoara, non-stop). Cluj hospital subpages (fmv.usamvcluj.ro/servicii-de-urgenta etc.) exist but were not openable. No duty_rota or poison_line found: no Romanian veterinary duty-rota page or animal poison line was located (the human poison centre was not searched for animal use). Not covered: Constanța/Mamaia, Brașov and mountain resorts, Sibiu, Timișoara own clinics. A follow-up run with other sources is needed.
